| Category | Synthesis |
|---|---|
| Subject | A governs **contractors**; B governs **on-call responders**. A contractor may possibly qualify separately as a responder, but contractor status alone is insufficient. |
| Allowed data | Contractors may read **incident summaries**. On-call responders may read **production logs**. A otherwise prohibits contractors from reading production logs. |
| Conditions | Incident-summary access requires **manager approval**. Production-log access requires **on-call responder status** and a **declared severity-1 incident**. |
| Conflict or ambiguity | For someone who is both a contractor and an on-call responder, A’s blanket log prohibition conflicts with B’s conditional permission. The excerpts do not specify whether B overrides A during severity-1 incidents. |
